		<h1 class="entry-title h1">Prime Gaming March 2025 free games and perks</h1>			<div class="entry-meta entry-meta-single"><div class="meta-item herald-date"><span class="updated">7 Mar 2025</span></div><div class="meta-item herald-author"><div class="coauthors "><span class="vcard author"><span class="fn"><a href="https://stevivor.com/author/stevivor/">Steve Wright</a></span></span></div></div></div>
	</header>				<div class="entry-content herald-entry-content">

	
	
				
			
	<h2 class="sub-title-primary">More for your library.</h2> <p><a href="https://stevivor.com/tag/twitch-prime/">Prime Gaming March 2025 free games and perks</a> have been detailed by Amazon and its partners, and we’ve got the list for you here.</p>
<p>Here’s what will become available to those who subscribe to Amazon Prime, thus Prime Gaming, over the month.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Last </strong><strong>month: </strong><a href="https://stevivor.com/news/releases/prime-gaming-february-2025-free-games-and-perks/">February 2025</a>  |  <strong>This month: </strong><a href="https://stevivor.com/news/releases/prime-gaming-march-2025-free-games-and-perks/">March 2025</a>  |  <strong>Next month: </strong><a href="https://stevivor.com/news/releases/prime-gaming-april-2025-free-games-and-perks/">April 2025</a></p>
<h3>Prime Gaming March 2025 freebies<strong> </strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><em>Saints Row: The Third Remastered </em>[GOG Code]<em> </em></li>
<li><em>Mafia II: Definitive Edition </em>[GOG Code]</li>
<li><em>Crime Boss: Rockay City </em>[Epic Games Store]<em> </em></li>
<li><em>Naheulbeuk’s Dungeon Master </em>[Amazon Games App]</li>
<li><em>Wall World </em>[Amazon Games App]</li>
<li><em>Syberia: The World Before </em>[GOG Code]</li>
<li><em>Endling – Extinction is Forever </em>[Amazon Games App]</li>
<li><em>Dark Deity: Complete Edition </em>[GOG Code]</li>
<li><em>Beholder 3 </em>[Amazon Games App]</li>
<li><em>Wolfenstein: The Old Blood </em>[Xbox and PC via Microsoft Store Code]</li>
</ul>
<h3>Extra freebies on Amazon Luna</h3>
<p>The titles directly below are only available in US, Canada, Germany, United Kingdom, France, Italy, Spain, Austria, the Netherlands, and Poland.</p>
<ul>
<li><em>WRC Generations Fully Loaded Edition</em></li>
<li><em>Overcooked! 2</em></li>
<li><em>Spitlings</em></li>
<li><em>The Jackbox Party Pack 3</em></li>
<li><em>Strange Horticulture</em></li>
<li><em>Fortnite OG</em></li>
<li><em>Fortnite Ballistic</em></li>
<li><em>LEGO® Fortnite Brick Life</em></li>
<li><em>Fortnite Battle Royale</em></li>
<li><em>Fortnite Festival</em></li>
<li><em>LEGO Fortnite Odyssey</em></li>
<li><em>Rocket Racing</em></li>
<li><em>Fortnite </em></li>
<li><em>Trackmania Starter Access</em></li>
<li><em>Fallout New Vegas: Ultimate Edition</em></li>
<li><em>Fallout 3: Game of the Year Edition</em></li>
</ul>
<p>As always, <a href="https://twitch.amazon.com/tp" target="_blank" rel="noopener">you can head here for more information and to claim your loot</a>. You can always grab <a href="https://stevivor.com/news/releases/prime-gaming-february-2025-free-games-and-perks/">last month’s games too</a> if you time it right!</p>
